request.title: ci: parallel gates with a persistent Vite Task cache
request.description:
The `ready` gate was ~5 minutes on every PR because CI starts with a cold Vite Task cache — every phase logged `0/14 cache hit (0%)`, so the durable crash matrices, soak, and Cloudflare pool suites re-ran even for PRs touching one package. Locally the same cache gets ~90% hit rates.

This ports the caching pattern proven in kommunikasie's `check.yml`:

- **Three parallel gates** — Static checks (`bun run check`), Tests (`bun run test`), Build (`bun run build`) — with a **fan-in job that keeps the required branch-protection check named `ready`** (no settings change needed; a failed gate skips the fan-in, which blocks merge as before).
- Each gate **restores/saves `node_modules/.vite/task-cache`** (~40MB): per-run immutable keys, separate namespaces per job (each saves only the entries it ran), restore-keys scoped to the current lockfile with a fallback across dependency bumps — safe either way, since Vite Task fingerprints inputs itself and ignores stale entries per task rather than trusting them.
- **Runs on `main` publish the shared baseline** that PR runs restore (PR-saved caches are scoped to their own merge ref).
- Concurrency cancellation for superseded runs, and **every step named** across `ci`, `pr-review`, `release`, and `formal` — no more raw `Run bun ./node_modules/...` in the job UI.

Expected effect: a PR touching one package replays the other thirteen packages' check/test/build from cache; with the three gates in parallel, wall time should drop from ~5 min toward the slowest changed slice. Two tasks currently self-invalidate (`example-demo#check`, `storage-cloudflare#test`) and always re-run — worth a follow-up look.

Note: this PR's own run is cold (no baseline exists yet) and the fan-out means it may be a touch slower than before per-job; the first merge to main publishes the baseline, and PRs after that get the speedup.

request.title: ci: persist per-package vitest caches so test tasks can replay
request.description:
## Summary

- The Tests job's Vite Task cache has **never hit in CI**: every run re-executed all package and example test suites (~4 minutes), even when nothing they depend on changed. Example: in [run 31894783571](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/actions/runs/31894783571/job/95036353394), 13/14 package test tasks and 4/5 example test tasks missed, while the Build job replayed 13/14 tasks in the same run.
- Fix: the [Tests job's cache restore/save steps](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/dan/ci-overrides-test-caching/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L102-L129) now persist Vitest's per-package cache directories (`packages/*/node_modules/.vite/vitest`, `examples/*/node_modules/.vite/vitest`) alongside the root `node_modules/.vite/task-cache`. With them present, unchanged packages replay and only PR-touched packages re-run their suites.

## What went wrong

Every test task missed with the same reason:

```
~/packages/sandbox$ vp test --passWithNoTests ○ cache miss: 'da39a3ee…' removed from 'packages/sandbox/node_modules/.vite/vitest', executing
```

Vitest maintains its own cache directory inside each package (`node_modules/.vite/vitest/<hash>/results.json`), and Vite Task's automatic file tracking records it in the test task's input fingerprint. The workflow persisted only the workspace-root `node_modules/.vite/task-cache`, so on every fresh runner the per-package directories were absent, the fingerprint never matched, and every test task re-executed — including the long integration suites (70s/53s/48s/35s in the linked run). The Actions cache layer itself was working (entries saved and restored each run); the restored fingerprints just could never match.

Build and static checks were unaffected: their tasks don't depend on the Vitest cache directories.

## Evidence

Reproduced and verified locally in a fresh worktree:

```
$ vp run -F './packages/sandbox' test    # first run: executes
$ vp run -F './packages/sandbox' test    # second run
vp run: cache hit, 864ms saved.

$ rm -rf packages/sandbox/node_modules/.vite/vitest
$ vp run -F './packages/sandbox' test    # exact CI miss reproduced: "removed from …/.vite/vitest", executes

$ vp run -F './packages/sandbox' test    # directory present again
vp run: cache hit, 785ms saved.
```

The hit after re-execution shows the fingerprint is stable across runs as long as the directory survives, so restoring it in CI is sufficient. A new package with no saved directory simply misses once, executes, and is captured by the next save (self-healing).

Known limitation (pre-existing, not addressed here): `@effect-agent/storage-cloudflare#test` and `example-code-mode-cloudflare#test` are reported by Vite Task as "not cached because they modified their inputs" and will still re-run every time until their input tracking is fixed.

request.title: feat(pr-review): add bounded remediation loop
request.description:
## Summary

- Add an immutable, authenticated review handoff to the existing read-only pr-review package, bound to repository, PR, exact reviewed head, review/profile fingerprints, and stable selected finding identities.
- Add a private trusted-local leaf proof with a separate bounded implementation Agent, jailed worktree tools, deterministic host validation and publication, one-attempt admission, and exact-head fresh re-review.
- Harden the trust boundaries found by the Effect architecture audit: NUL-delimited Git status parsing, binary/path fail-closed behavior, distinct digest brands, explicit Crypto requirements, host-observed check validation, and typed resource cleanup.

## Architecture and authority

The packaged reviewer remains read-only; it receives no edit or publication capability. The implementation Agent receives only allowlisted read/search/edit, patch inspection, and named-check tools. It receives no GitHub credential, provider secret, shell, or push tool. Host Effect code owns the attempt claim, final diff and digest, required checks, stale-head compare-and-swap, commit publication, and the fresh reviewer.

The local adapter is deliberately class E trusted-local evidence. It is not an enabled workflow and makes no production isolation claim. Repository checks must not execute untrusted PR code alongside credentials or provider secrets.

Vital review paths:

- [Review handoff contracts](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/dan/pr-remediation-loop/packages/pr-review/src/internal/handoff.ts)
- [Deterministic host loop](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/dan/pr-remediation-loop/examples/pr-remediation/src/loop.ts)
- [Trusted-local Git/worktree adapter](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/dan/pr-remediation-loop/examples/pr-remediation/src/local-git.ts)
- [Offline real-Git evidence](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/dan/pr-remediation-loop/examples/pr-remediation/test/pr-remediation-loop.test.ts)
- [Security posture and usage](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/dan/pr-remediation-loop/examples/pr-remediation/README.md)

## Evidence

- Focused suite: 2 files, 12 tests passed.
- Full repository validation: vp run check passed with 0 errors; the existing repository warning baseline remains.
- Deterministic cases cover success, path escape, false check claims, independently failed checks, stale and inconsistent heads, add/remove/rename/binary Git evidence, control-character paths, interruption cleanup, typed cleanup failure, one-attempt admission, and fresh re-review.

request.description:
## Summary

- add a public Effect-native DurableAgentRuntime.awaitProgress boundary backed by conversation-keyed scoped wake registrations
- carry the boundary through the Cloudflare Conversation Object RPC and CloudflareConversationClient, including explicit interruption cancellation and reset-safe reconstruction
- emit best-effort hints only after authoritative durable mutations, while keeping canonical records authoritative
- document the subscribe/read/park contract and add the required minor changeset

## Correctness

The runtime installs a one-shot registration before its one-record canonical read. A commit in either the subscribe/check or check/park seam completes the deferred hint, while an already-committed record returns immediately. Hints may be dropped, duplicated, or false-positive; callers always re-read canonical storage.

Wake delivery broadcasts to every scoped waiter for one conversation only. Scope finalizers remove interrupted or timed-out registrations. The Cloudflare host adds a bounded disposable cancellation registry, broadcasts cancellation across overlapping retry attempts, and retries only platform-classified Durable Object resets with a fresh stub. Reconstructed waits repeat registration plus the authoritative read.

Every canonical append now notifies after commit. Approval and unknown-resolution ledger intents, abort, child/parent/host wakes, and terminal settlement paths retain their existing durable ordering and typed failures.

request.title: fix(pr-review): spell the committable-suggestion contract out to fan-out discovery workers
request.description:
## Summary

- Fan-out (assured multi-pass) reviews were publishing GitHub suggestion blocks containing prose advice ("Move `state.storage.setAlarm(...)` before …") instead of committable replacement code. This spells the finding JSON shape — anchor rule and suggestion rule included — out to the [discovery worker instructions](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/10257fc58f99ba3a4eed64eaea479a1acbb29660/packages/pr-review/src/internal/fan-out.ts#L278-L279), mirroring the single-pass reviewer's wording.
- `ReviewFinding.suggestion` now carries the same contract as a [schema `description` annotation](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/10257fc58f99ba3a4eed64eaea479a1acbb29660/packages/pr-review/src/internal/review-agent.ts#L349-L355), so the [rendered final-output contract](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/10257fc58f99ba3a4eed64eaea479a1acbb29660/packages/engine/src/output-contract-internal.ts#L52-L65) shows the rule to the model wherever the schema travels, independent of any one prompt.
- The committed Action bundle is rebuilt.

## What went wrong

#117 moved Action reviews to the fan-out pipeline by default (`PR_REVIEW_FAN_OUT=true`). In that pipeline, findings are produced by `pr-review-worker` discovery children — but their instructions only said "up to 6 findings" without ever stating the finding contract. The only model-visible definition of `suggestion` was the JSON schema of `FileReviewReport`, where it was a bare optional string: the "Replacement for exactly lines startLine..endLine" text above the field is a TypeScript doc comment, which never reaches the model. Faced with an undescribed field named `suggestion`, live models fill it with advice prose, and nothing downstream corrects it — the verifier assesses the claim, not the payload; host projection validates only anchors; and the renderer fences whatever the field holds as a ```suggestion``` block.

The single-pass reviewer never regressed because its prompt spells the rule out explicitly — and the comment above it states the principle the fan-out path violated: "Live models diverge wherever the contract is implicit, so the exact JSON shape, the anchor rule, and the suggestion rule are all spelled out with types."

Rejected alternative: making the verification pass reject candidates whose suggestion is not committable code. A malformed suggestion would then suppress a true finding, and a strip-the-suggestion channel would widen the assessment schema; making the contract explicit at discovery time addresses the cause instead.

## Evidence

The model-visible output contract (what `outputSchemaContract` renders into every discovery child's prompt) now carries the rule on the property node:

```json
"suggestion": {
  "type": "string",
  "description": "Committable replacement source code for exactly lines startLine..endLine: the full replacement for every line in the range and nothing else — never prose describing the change, which belongs in body.",
  "allOf": [{ "maxLength": 2000 }]
}
```

Regression test: [`spells the finding shape and committable-suggestion rule out to discovery workers`](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/10257fc58f99ba3a4eed64eaea479a1acbb29660/packages/pr-review/test/pr-review-fanout.test.ts#L352-L368) asserts both the discovery instructions and the generated output schema carry the contract.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

+---
+
+Spell the finding shape and committable-suggestion rule out to fan-out discovery workers, and annotate `ReviewFinding.suggestion` with the same contract so the model-visible output schema carries it. Fan-out reviews no longer publish GitHub suggestion blocks containing prose advice instead of replacement code.

request.title: fix(pr-review): compare rewritten heads by tree snapshots
request.description:
## Summary

- Keep amended and force-pushed reviews incremental by comparing the prior and current commit tree snapshots across a bounded PR and continuity path set.
- Hydrate every selected path from the current full PR file record, preserving patches, rename metadata, additions, deletions, and mode or object-type changes.
- Fall back to the full PR with an explicit review reason when a commit or tree is unavailable, malformed, mismatched, or truncated. The committed Action bundle and package docs are updated.

## What went wrong

`PriorReviews.compareTrees` called GitHub's compare-commits REST route with `base..head`. GitHub does not support that spelling, so the request returned 404. `runReviewAction` converted the typed lookup failure to `undefined`; because the force-pushed reviewed head was no longer an ancestor, `selectReviewRange` conservatively chose the full PR.

Changing the separator to `...` would still compare from the merge base and could return essentially the whole pull request after an amend. This change instead uses GitHub's supported Git commit and recursive tree endpoints.

## Architecture

- The [GitHub adapter resolves each commit to its tree and compares schema-decoded entries](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/792c92eaab7cd212fe387c332526948eeac12caa/packages/pr-review/src/internal/github.ts#L1071). It treats path presence, object SHA, mode, and type as content identity, rejects duplicate or malformed entries, and marks either recursive tree's `truncated` response incomplete. GitHub documents the recursive response bound and truncation contract in [Get a tree](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/git/trees#get-a-tree).
- The Action supplies at most 300 current PR records with current and previous paths, plus the already bounded stored continuity paths. It [retains tree lookup failures for scope selection](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/792c92eaab7cd212fe387c332526948eeac12caa/packages/pr-review/src/action.ts#L650).
- The [path-only `ReviewTreeComparison` and range selector](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/792c92eaab7cd212fe387c332526948eeac12caa/packages/pr-review/src/internal/review-state.ts#L405) verify the requested head pair, reject truncation, and select only matching current PR records. No synthetic compare payload becomes model evidence.
- This branch is rebased on the merged [#157](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/pull/157) and leaves its path-bound retry-stage behavior intact.

## Evidence

- The reported [kommunikasie job](https://github.com/reve-ai/kommunikasie/actions/runs/32770965372/job/97570966309?pr=854) produced this [56-file review](https://github.com/reve-ai/kommunikasie/pull/854#pullrequestreview-5012076457), consuming 121,452 input and 30,211 output tokens over 12 minutes for an intended small amended-head delta.
- The [GitHub adapter regression](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/792c92eaab7cd212fe387c332526948eeac12caa/packages/pr-review/test/github.test.ts#L112) proves no compare route is used and covers unchanged blobs, additions, deletions, mode changes, object-type changes, rename paths, PR-path intersection, malformed entries, and truncated trees.
- The [range-selection regressions](https://github.com/danieljvdm/effect-agent/blob/792c92eaab7cd212fe387c332526948eeac12caa/packages/pr-review/test/review-state.test.ts#L450) prove a diverged head selects only changed current PR records with full patches and rename metadata, while failed or truncated snapshots select the full PR.
- Focused package validation passed: 13 test files, 191 tests passed and 1 skipped; package type check and build passed. The Action bundle rebuilt to 2,132,170 bytes, and a second post-commit rebuild left the worktree clean.
- `vp run ready` reached the repository static scan with 0 errors, then Vite+ failed to spawn `packages/sandbox#check` with `Invalid argument (os error 22)`. The independent `vp check` rerun completed with 0 errors; CI remains responsible for the full repository task graph.

+

+Fall back to a full review with an observable reason when either snapshot is unavailable, malformed,
